meaning.zh:
“在关键时刻” 或 “在危急时刻”。

这个成语起源于赌博，尤其是扑克游戏。当赌注已经下完的时候（“chips” 指代赌注），局势变得更加严峻和关键。“When the chips are down” 用来形容人在重大压力或者危急情况下所采取的行为和决定。
meaning.en: This idiom originated from the context of gambling, particularly poker. When the chips (bets) are all on the table, the situation becomes more serious and critical. "When the chips are down" is used to describe how people behave or make decisions under significant pressure or in critical situations.

lines.en: You can always count on him *when the chips are down.*
lines.zh: 在关键时刻，你总是能指望他。

lines.en: *When the chips are down*, true friends will be there for you.
lines.zh: 危急时刻，真正的朋友会陪在你身边。

lines.en: *When the chips are down*, she always finds a way to succeed.
lines.zh: 在关键时刻，她总能找到成功的道路。
